1. **The stop latch is different from the existing one-stop latch.** Adapter lines 505–510 consult `worker.shutdown_started`. Use the existing exact pair's attempt/observation state. A consumed stop attempt must lead only to bounded retained-process/job observation or refusal, never another termination. Add a control that first drives the real quarantine method and verifies no second termination call.

2. **The probe requires a pre-quarantine revision after quarantine.** Adapter line 213 captures `token.revision` before raising the interruption. Lines 247, 249 and 276 demand that value during reconciliation/close. `revoke_local` and `quarantine` increment the revision (S10:394–406), so real quarantine makes these equalities false. A cleanup failure escapes as a different primary error. Keep the exact interruption primary across observer/coordinator failures and add bounded cleanup notes, following the existing adapter rule at S03:226–239. The proposed last test does not assert primary-error identity.

4. **The six tests do not reach the advertised adapter interruption path.** The fixture supplies an empty `SimpleNamespace` as `pipes` (test line 29). Its `interrupted()` method sets index 2 and invokes the probe/manual quarantine directly (152–163), bypassing the adapter, stream and admitted `OwnedSession._call`. During lease exit, the real delegate then calls the missing `pipes._quarantine` (S06:256–265). `_flush_quarantine` catches that error before its service append (proposed durable:286–298), so the expected fourth frame/flush is not established. Supply an explicit inert pipe/native seam that reaches real quarantine and its latch, then drive the actual adapter/operation entry for the connection case. Keep all native calls fake and assert the exact reached boundaries, aggregate history, unchanged original error and absence of extra wire requests. The current positive fixture is not evidence that these seams connect.

5. **Actual quarantine is refused at the manager entry.** Durable lines 201–202 reject `pair.unconfirmed`. The actual path necessarily sets it in S07:150, even when all handle owners remain confirmed and no I/O is retained. This contradicts the separate-witness design. Keep the aggregate history; admit only the exact published quarantined owner with empty/idle I/O and confirmed retained handle records. Preserve ordinary pipe/worker/read-set retirement refusals. 6. **An already-closed uncertain client skips preflight.** Durable lines 208–214 omit `pair.client` when it is closed. Validate the exact retained identity and confirmed closed state of an already-retired optional client before any OS work; require ordinary live-owner checks when it remains open. Add that specific no-side-effect refusal beside the existing open-client uncertainty case.

7. **The new journal receipt hashes the wrong prefix.** Journal setup line 268 hashes `probe.raw`, the three-frame pre-interruption snapshot. Line 267 labels that digest as the four-frame pre-recovery state. Hash `probe.quarantine_raw` for that field, retaining the earlier snapshot under its distinct meaning.
